crossRefs.note: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you…
For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out…
He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
Teach me your way, Yahweh. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should…
then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Israel, when you teach them the good way…

translations.web: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
translations.bsb: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
translations.kjv: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
translations.asv: I declared my ways, and thou answeredst me: Teach me thy statutes.
